description: Estimate the sealed points a Provenance Envelope of a given action type could carry — priced by the SAME derivation the settlement money path runs (action policy → runtime monetary policy → operational disposition), never a documentation table or the retired weight-framework formula. The answer carries mint_disposition beside the number: duplicate-count guards, draft witnesses, and terminal denials return 0 explicitly. Public and unauthenticated. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The PE mints its base; telemetry and independence multiply on top.

action_type.description: PE action type to estimate (e.g. agent_tool_orchestration).

count.description: How many identical PEs to model repetition over (there is no per-user volume cap and no time-based reduction; repetition is priced by novelty, and exact duplicates mint 0). A non-negative integer. Optional; default 0.

novelty.description: How many PEs of this action type the identity has ALREADY recorded (drives novelty decay). A non-negative integer occurrence count, not a 0–1 factor. Optional; default 0.

name: get_pvt_estimate
